posts.name: Zoom Slides
posts.tagline: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides
posts.description: Zoom Slides is an AI-powered presentation maker that turns your meetings, documents, and ideas into polished, editable decks. Instead of starting from a blank slide, let Zoom AI turn meeting transcripts and summaries into structured presentations with professional layouts, visuals, and speaker notes. Refine content with AI, collaborate with teammates, and export to PowerPoint. Your meeting ends, and your presentation is already taking shape.

posts.name: Boost.space AgentOS
posts.tagline: One operating system for all your AI agents
posts.description: Build your agent-driven company with specialized agents that share context, skills, and tools. Deploy, control, manage and chat or talk to your agents with access to more than 1,400 AI models and access to more than 1,500 tools you already use.

posts.name: OpenBot
posts.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: self-host, fully customize, any stack
posts.description: Build your own enterprise-ready agent workspace that's modular and self-hostable. Designed with a clean architecture and built-in governance. Bring any agent- then choose the models, tools, and infra they run on. Use as-is, white-label it, or deeply customize it.

posts.name: readywhen
posts.tagline: Your personal assistant that lives in email around the clock
posts.description: readywhen is the personal assistant on email. Email it a job, the same way you'd email a good assistant. It writes the follow-up, sends it from your email when you reply "send", then watches for the answer. Ask what you're waiting on. Nothing goes out without your OK. Just email assistant@readywhen.ai to get started. No account setup needed.

posts.name: OpenFrame
posts.tagline: AI agents that run your IT. You approve every fix.
posts.description: OpenFrame gives small IT teams two AI agents to handle the work that never ends. Mingo patches devices, fixes issues, and handles routine technical tasks, with every change approved by your admin. Fae answers employee IT requests so your team can focus without constant interruptions. A weekly report shows leadership what got done. Endpoint management, AI agents, and IT support in one platform for $1 per device.

posts.name: Cal.com v7
posts.tagline: Cal.com now has events, discover, an assistant + more
posts.description: Officially launching Cal.com Events, Cal.com Discover, Cal.ai Assistant, a new brand and more!

posts.name: ChatGPT Wallet
posts.tagline: Let ChatGPT agents buy things without seeing your card
posts.description: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's "dots" agents finish purchases for you. The card network gives the agent a payment token, so neither the agent nor the merchant ever sees your card number. You review the items, the total and the card before each purchase, then approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.

posts.name: Cookie Away
posts.tagline: Rejects cookie banners for you, even the sneaky ones
posts.description: Cookie Away is a free, open-source Chrome extension that rejects cookie banners for you. No reject button? It opens the settings, switches everything off and saves. It never pays to say no, checks every click, and we published its results on 69 sites.

posts.name: Trusty CSV
posts.tagline: Edit CSV files like code, not like a spreadsheet
posts.description: Data prep without the project, the flow or the script. Open a CSV and work on the file itself: cluster similar values, pivot, join, filter, or just type in a cell. Every step is one Ctrl+Z, and a diff of the saved file shows only what you changed.

posts.name: Puffin
posts.tagline: Identity and inboxes for AI agents
posts.description: Give each AI agent its own email address, a seat in Discord, Slack and Telegram, and a calendar. It replies with built-in AI or your own agent: you approve every message, or let it run on full autopilot.

posts.name: StateWeave
posts.tagline: Test your AI agent on working clones of the apps it uses
posts.description: StateWeave runs your AI agent in sandboxes of the apps it works in: stateful clones of Slack, Gmail, Salesforce, Shopify, Zendesk, Google Calendar, Sheets, Drive, WhatsApp and Teams, with the same APIs, MCP servers and UIs as the real thing. Describe a scenario to fill every app with consistent data, inject faults like outages and 401s, and get graded runs showing which checks failed and the exact calls behind them. Fresh copy every run.

posts.name: Pharen Hub
posts.tagline: One AI workspace for your whole company
posts.description: Pharen Hub brings projects, tasks, docs, mail, meetings, data and AI agents into one workspace with one shared context. Agents work with clear goals, allowed sources and human approval. Hosted in the EU or on your own servers. Fair-code, source on GitHub. Free plan to start.

posts.name: Curates
posts.tagline: The all-in-one platform for creators
posts.description: Curates is where creatives keep, share and show their work. Send clients a review link with comments, approvals and downloads. Add any photo to your portfolio website in two clicks and build a private showcase for every project. No exports, no re-uploads.

posts.name: ByteVoice
posts.tagline: Talk to your coding agents and hear them back
posts.description: Talk to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent instead of typing, hear their summaries, and reply directly to agents.

posts.name: Flamigo
posts.tagline: Turn rough notes into beautifully designed slides
posts.description: Paste your notes, review the outline, and let Flamigo design the slides. Compare designs for a slide, then fine-tune its layout in the editor. Start free and export to HTML, or export to PowerPoint with editable text on Pro.

posts.name: Blomma for Organizations
posts.tagline: Scale your people at the speed of your business
posts.description: HR teams are stretched thin, and most people never get a coach. Blomma gives every manager and employee a proactive AI career coach that knows your company, so your people team can scale. • Coaching grounded in your values, competencies and OKRs • 1:1 prep, feedback, hard conversations, reviews and onboarding • Checks in, tracks goals and keeps people accountable • Private by default: admins see only aggregate insights and your conversations always stay private.

posts.name: UI SDK by Vercel
posts.tagline: Give AI agents the building blocks to create UI
posts.description: UI SDK gives AI agents reusable interface behaviors to build custom, accessible UI components. Use one core library across React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components.

posts.name: Freebuff
posts.tagline: The 100% free coding agent
posts.description: Code, build and deploy apps, and chat with AI for free. Work in your browser, desktop or terminal with Freebuff.

posts.name: Punchcutter
posts.tagline: Turn a sentence or your handwriting into a real font family
posts.description: Punchcutter is a free, open-source Agent Skill and MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and Cursor. Describe a typeface or photograph your handwriting and get a real font family: TTF, OTF, variable and webfonts, with its own Studio app.

posts.name: Centralize
posts.tagline: Relationship Workspace for Enterprise Deal Teams
posts.description: Account mapping software that automatically maps stakeholders, identifies buying committee gaps, surfaces warm paths, and recommends next actions for enterprise deals.

posts.name: Findy
posts.tagline: Find Files on Your Mac by what you remember
posts.description: A Mac app that finds files from plain-language searches such as “pdfs from gmail last week”, "videos over 1GB", "photos from Greece" and by the text inside images and PDFs. Everything stays on the Mac.

posts.name: Fluid
posts.tagline: speech-to-speech built to solve problems
posts.description: Fluid is a speech-to-speech model built to solve problems. On τ²-bench it resolves 84% of support tasks. It speaks 24+ languages and 52 dialects. It talks like a person, delegates to the frontier model of your choice and works with OpenAI's Live Protocol.

posts.name: Glifa
posts.tagline: The Markdown editor for Mac you can ask for anything
posts.description: Glifa is a Mac Markdown editor with the AI inside the document. Select text, press ⇧⌘R and type what you need, like "turn these notes into a table" or "make this sound less like a robot wrote it". There are also 18 built-in actions. It works with Claude Code or Codex on your plan, Apple Intelligence, a local model or your own key. The editor has live preview, math, Mermaid and Obsidian vaults. 15-day free trial.

posts.name: Newsology
posts.tagline: Follow news as it develops and see how every side tells it.
posts.description: Newsology puts every outlet’s coverage side by side so you can compare it, sums up each topic’s biggest stories in one place, shows who owns each outlet, and gives every article a Bias Breakdown. Start free, no card needed.

posts.name: Docsy
posts.tagline: Open source docs for humans and coding agents
posts.description: Build beautiful docs from Markdown, OpenAPI and native SDK documentation. Customize with YAML, host it yourself, and give coding agents structured context to maintain articles, references and examples through reviewable draft PRs.

posts.name: Pine Drama Studio
posts.tagline: The open-source Cursor for AI filmmaking
posts.description: Pine Drama Studio is an open-source desktop studio for AI filmmaking. Bring your screenplay and collaborate with AI agents to create characters, locations, storyboards, shots, and final cuts. Direct the production through chat, review and approve results on a visual canvas, and customize your production workflows. Built on Code-OSS and powered by Pine Computer. Your project lives in a local folder on your Mac.

posts.name: OffiAI
posts.tagline: Office, with its last two letters swapped for AI.
posts.description: A free Mac app that gives your Claude Code, Codex, Cowork and Gemini sessions desks in a 3D office. Brief agents at Reception, answer approvals, review finished work and see what changed. No account, no analytics; nothing reaches us unless you send feedback.

posts.name: LingoMic
posts.tagline: Speak your language in meetings, they hear theirs
posts.description: LingoMic is a Chrome extension that translates your voice live in online meetings. Speak your own language and others hear the translation through a virtual microphone, in Google Meet, Zoom and Teams on the web. No bot joins the call. It also shows translated captions in 24 languages and writes AI notes with decisions and action items. Uses your own Gemini API key; a free key works. 30 minutes free, then plans from $29 for 6 months or $79 lifetime.

posts.name: Kafkador
posts.tagline: A console for to manage, observe & play Apache Kafka
posts.description: Kafkador is a powerful Kafka administration dashboard designed to give engineering teams full visibility and control over their Kafka clusters. It centralizes monitoring, configuration, and operational insights into a single, intuitive interface with an AI assistant.

posts.name: LexiCAD
posts.tagline: Describe a part in plain language to get a CAD design
posts.description: Describe a part in plain language. LexiCAD's AI agent designs it in CAD, measures it against what you asked for, and gives you STEP, STL, 3MF and DXF files.

posts.name: Papyras
posts.tagline: For people who still read the last page
posts.description: Blogs are out and AIs are in, but some of us still read the last page. Papyras is for them. Read 5,000+ public-domain classics for free, set in Garamond and Caslon and turned like two-page spreads, with bookmarks that remember the paragraph. Writers get a calm, book-like editor: write chapter by chapter, publish with a cover and contents page in a few clicks, and get help from an AI that runs on your own computer. A blog is there too, if you want one.

posts.name: AgentWatch
posts.tagline: Monitor AI shopping agent sales and visibility on Shopify
posts.description: See how much revenue AI shopping agents like ChatGPT bring your Shopify store, check the catalog and UCP/MCP surfaces they rely on, and get email alerts when sales drop or something breaks. Read-only, privacy-first, free plan.

posts.name: Nexus
posts.tagline: Make agents deploy your AI products faster for customers
posts.description: Nexus is a self-learning context layer that helps forward deployed (FDE) teams move faster. It structures your deployment context into something proactive, adaptive, and that does all the work for you including codifying playbooks, surfacing and shipping product signal, taking high priority tasks, and highlighting repeatable work. This means agents take on your most complex FDE work and deliver it fast and reliably for customers.

posts.name: Degla AI
posts.tagline: Your intent. Onboard Autonomous Execution.
posts.description: Degla AI builds autonomy software that enables drones to understand spoken instructions, reason onboard, and adapt as the mission unfolds. An operator can say, “Find the missing hiker wearing a red sweater.” The drone plans the mission, interprets what it sees, and adjusts its flight as new information emerges. The operator sets the objective and the aircraft handles the execution. Once you’ve expressed your intent, the system owns the problem.

posts.name: Intelligent Eyewear
posts.tagline: Samsung and Google bring Gemini AI to smart eyewear
posts.description: Samsung Intelligent Eyewear brings Google Gemini into lightweight smart glasses designed with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. Ask questions about what you see, translate menus, navigate with Google Maps, capture photos and videos, and manage messages hands-free. Featuring a 12MP camera, open-ear audio, up to 9 hours of battery life, and 30 design variations. Preorders are open in the U.S., starting at $395, with availability beginning December 10.

posts.name: Laurence
posts.tagline: Build a frontier e-commerce growth system
posts.description: Laurence enables brands to build autonomous growth systems in e-commerce, starting with Amazon Ads & DSP. It is a full-stack AI company: models run the account and people review the work, so brands get both frontier autonomy and an expert human deployment team.

posts.name: Notebook to Notes
posts.tagline: Move your OneNote notebooks to Apple Notes, 100% offline
posts.description: Move your Microsoft OneNote notebooks to Apple Notes on your Mac. Download them from OneDrive, drop thezip in the app and click Import. Sections become folders, each page becomes a note with its original dates, To Do tags become native checklists, and tables, colors, images, files, audio, drawings and links between pages come along. No Microsoft login and nothing uploaded: everything runs on your Mac. $19, one-time.

posts.name: Zode
posts.tagline: The fastest, cheapest cloud VMs for agents
posts.description: Zode runs Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode in parallel sandboxes that fork in under a second with Docker and caches intact. A flight recorder shows what every agent did, a ledger shows what each PR cost, and your API keys never enter the sandbox.

posts.name: Celesto
posts.tagline: CI for coding agents: 90% cheaper, 25% faster builds
posts.description: Celesto CI is a cheaper alternative to GitHub Actions with up to 25% faster builds, built for agent-scale development where coding agents push code continuously.

posts.name: BeautyOS
posts.tagline: A free beauty salon OS that ChatGPT sets up for you
posts.description: BeautyOS is a free operating system for beauty salons: calendar, client CRM, inbox and online booking. You don't fill it in by hand. Open the BeautyOS app in ChatGPT or add the skill to Claude Code, Codex or Hermes Agent, then share your website, price list or just describe your salon. The agent sets up services, prices, staff and booking, showing every change before it's applied. Need more? Add an AI receptionist for WhatsApp, Instagram and calls.

posts.name: Dictate Safe
posts.tagline: Dictation for Mac and Windows that runs on your computer
posts.description: Hold a key, speak, and Dictate Safe types your words into whatever app you are using, on Mac or Windows. Speech is turned into text on your own computer by default, and you need no account to dictate. It has Code Mode for dictating symbols, a prompt library you search from a floating icon, and Keep Awake for long tasks. English only. One payment, no subscription. 25 free dictations, no account and no card.

posts.name: Jumpstart by WP Multitool
posts.tagline: Finds the plugins slowing WordPress, one click to fix
posts.description: Jumpstart names the plugins slowing your WordPress homepage and dashboard, keeps them off the dashboard in one click, cleans up, and checks the site after.

posts.name: Addness
posts.tagline: Share your goals and context with your AI agents
posts.description: Addness is a context management tool. It shares your goals and the context behind them (what's been decided, who owns what) with AI agents like Claude Code and Codex. Agents read a goal first, ask a teammate when stuck, and add what they did to the goal.

posts.name: MacVisor
posts.tagline: Run your Mac as a virtualization host
posts.description: macOS, Windows 11, Linux and FreeBSD VMs setup automatically with account, SSH keys and guest tools: a MacBook becomes a dev box, a Mac mini or Studio a headless virtualization host you drive remotely, from the mvz CLI, or the built-in MCP server; run by a background service, with snapshots, networks and a firewall, scheduled backups, AI sandboxes, OCI images, VM auto-start and high availability, and other advanced features.

posts.name: Strokes
posts.tagline: Desktop writing app with offline AI and built-in readers
posts.description: Strokes is a desktop editor for people who work with text most of their day. In Strokes you’ll find a personal AI writer, trained specifically to help you write in your own style faster, with no loss of quality. And you know what? The AI works both online and offline. Want full privacy? You got it. Built-in readers help you get feedback before you send your work to anyone. Available on Mac and Windows, with a free plan.

posts.name: WeConnect
posts.tagline: Enterprise operating platform for people and AI
posts.description: WeConnect is one portal for HR, payroll, recruitment, learning, projects, sales, accounting and inventory, on one shared data layer. People and AI agents work side by side, governed by roles. A built-in copilot and one MCP connector let Claude or any assistant work across every department. Indian payroll (PF, ESI, TDS) and GST accounting are included.

posts.name: Crease
posts.tagline: Local cricket, taken seriously ;).
posts.description: Crease is the home for local cricket. Score your matches ball by ball, follow live games near you, and watch your player card grow every time you play. Scoring, player cards, stats and following matches are free. Team Pro and tournament options are available for teams and organisers who want more. Everything is free right now. Works on Android, iPhone and the web at crease.expo.app.

posts.name: Poop Awaymo
posts.tagline: A bird that hates AI and a city full of white robotaxis.
posts.description: You are a bird. The city is full of white robotaxis. You have 90 seconds and a full digestive system.

posts.name: Humy.ai
posts.tagline: Simulations of historical figures based on real sources
posts.description: Students can now interview 100,000 historical figures on Humy, from 223 countries and territories and from the ancient world to today. The most-taught figures answer from real sources we indexed from 12 public archives, including the Library of Congress, Europeana, the U.S. National Archives, and The Met. Humy copies each quote word for word from the document and links back to it, so students can check it and discover new sources.

posts.name: Hamza
posts.tagline: Prayer reminders that open from your Mac's notch
posts.description: Hamza is a small, native macOS menu-bar app for salah. At each prayer, a reminder opens from your Mac's notch with the time, what comes next and where you are, then closes on its own. The rest of the day, it waits in your menu bar with a countdown and today's times. Choose from 12 calculation methods, Hanafi or standard Asr, and a high-latitude rule. No notch? It opens from a small island instead. Times are calculated on your Mac, with no account and no tracking. Free.

posts.name: Kavela
posts.tagline: Personal AI Assistant for your Job
posts.description: Personal assistant for your job. Powered by your Claude / Codex subscriptions. Connect anything. Scalable, Observable, Secure.

posts.name: OliDrop
posts.tagline: Easily send original photos and videos to family and friends
posts.description: Send full quality photos and videos to your family and friends, around. It works like Airdrop, but without needing to be next to each other. Unlike other products, media is saved directly to your photo gallery. No sign-up, no email, no password.

posts.name: Nurture: Plant Care App
posts.tagline: The plant care app that doesn't paywall the basics, for real
posts.description: Most plant apps paywall the basics. Nurture doesn't. Free, with unlimited plants: reminders for watering, fertilizing, repotting or any task you make up, all due at once in one notification; schedules that ease off in winter; a care guide for every plant; plant ID from a photo, 3 a month; a care history with photos. A small ad keeps it free. For heavy users, Premium removes ads and adds more IDs, plant diagnosis and backup; the Household plan shares your plants with family or a plant sitter.

posts.name: KundliToday
posts.tagline: Real planet positions, classical books, your own kundli
posts.description: KundliToday is a free Vedic astrology site co-founded by Acharya Mahendra Pandey of Kashi, 15+ years in astrology. Real planet positions, classical books, your own kundli.

posts.name: Betterwords
posts.tagline: The AI writing app that helps you say the hard things, well.
posts.description: Betterwords.ai is a writing app that helps you craft the difficult messages in your life. It's a calm, end-to-end writing companion for the delicate messages that you struggle the most — setting a boundary, disputing a charge, speaking up — and it helps you to visualize how each way of saying it is likely to land.

posts.name: WePicked
posts.tagline: Pick a group gift together, with a little AI help
posts.description: WePicked helps friends choose a group gift. Create a private group, invite people with a link, and combine their ideas, interests and budget. AI searches the web for gift ideas with links to shops. Works in your browser in eight languages. Your first gift search is free; later gifts cost EUR 1.99 and include one search. Products are bought separately.

posts.name: EasyTomato
posts.tagline: A new AI powered map
posts.description: We built a new AI harness and layout engine for maps. Unlike traditional maps which are a pre-drawn and mostly static. This one is built just for you and you prompt, on the fly, in an instant!

posts.name: ExpoKit
posts.tagline: Copy-paste React Native components for Expo, iOS & Android
posts.description: Production-ready React Native components for Expo, built for iPhone and Android first. Add one with a single CLI command and the code lives in your project. Try each one live in Expo Go first. Charts, maps, 3D, gestures and more.

posts.name: Linktwos
posts.tagline: Text a matchmaker - Meet the person you need.
posts.description: Linktwos gets you to the people you need. Tell the matchmaker who you’re looking for and it finds someone who needs you too. Nobody can message until you both say yes, and if you ignore your introductions they stop coming as frequently, so people actually reply. At an event, scan in with the code to see who in the room is worth meeting. Organisers can also run speed networking through the app. It isn’t a social media platform. It’s who you know. Available on the App Store and Android now.

posts.name: Megamesh.sh
posts.tagline: Your own self-hosted WireGuard VPN, with one-click deploy
posts.description: Your own VPN, self-hosted and built on WireGuard. Install it on a small VPS with a one-click deployer, a readable script or an AI-agent prompt. Free, open source, MIT. A personal VPN, not an anonymity service: read the limits first.

posts.name: My Sleep Calculator
posts.tagline: Sleep Calculator: Find Your Bedtime & Wake-Up Time
posts.description: Use our free sleep calculator to find your bedtime or wake-up time. Adjust time to fall asleep and compare 7.5, 8 or 9 hours of sleep to plan your night.

posts.name: Descant
posts.tagline: Your zero-config software factory
posts.description: Descant is your zero-config software factory. It merged 14,647 pull requests building itself, with 5 reverted. Its next frontier is proving software: first-ever try at Lean autonomously built an open-source Unicode segmentation library, complete with proofs Lean checked, in one shot. Within Descant, different models challenge each other through structured contracts and evidence-backed correctness checks. Zero-config, zero-trust cloud environments. Costs tracked per piece of work down to the cent

posts.name: WPReturns
posts.tagline: The WooCommerce returns plugin that keeps the sale
posts.description: For WooCommerce stores that lose sales to returns. Customers start a return from My Account or a guest portal and pick a refund, exchange or store credit. You approve and resolve it on one screen inside WordPress, with no per-return fee and no data leaving your store. The free plugin includes the EU withdrawal button now required for EU shops. Pro adds exchanges, store credit, labels, rules, fraud flags and analytics.

posts.name: SistematikWork
posts.tagline: See how any part is made, and what it should cost
posts.description: SistematikWork is a free industrial engineering platform that shows how any part is made. Search any part and get its full manufacturing route, from raw material to finished part: the process, the steps, the materials it suits, and the tolerances it can hold. The finder is free. Unlock one part for $2, or go Pro for the full dossier: should-cost at your volume, cost drivers, sourcing and MOQ, an RFQ checklist and a quote checker. Cost figures are model estimates, not quotes.

posts.name: Clementine CSA
posts.tagline: Your CSA's members, payments and packing in one place
posts.description: Clementine keeps CSA sign-ups, members, recurring payments and packing lists together. $29/month or $169/year per farm, with no per-member fee or cut of sales. Stripe processing fees apply. Built for U.S. farms. Explore an example without an account.

posts.name: ShareWithGuests
posts.tagline: Beautiful Event Links for Your Guests
posts.description: ShareWithGuests turns your event into one shareable link. Pick a theme, add your photos, then switch on the apps your guests need: find their seat on the floor plan, the day's schedule, the menu with dietary notes, a quiz played from their phones, and a shared reel where every photo and video lands in one place. Made for weddings, birthdays, christenings and trips away. Free to set up, then pay once per event when you're ready to share.

posts.name: Cliedesk
posts.tagline: An AI help desk that runs inside your WordPress admin
posts.description: Cliedesk is a complete help desk built as a WordPress plugin: shared inbox, live chat, help center and customer portal in one place. An AI agent answers customers and can act on their WooCommerce orders, while a copilot drafts every reply for your team. It's for WordPress and WooCommerce stores that don't want support data living in another SaaS: tickets stay in your own database, and the AI runs on your own API key.

posts.name: krot.io
posts.tagline: Automate your agencies Email and LinkedIn outreach.
posts.description: Krot runs your agency's business development: email and LinkedIn sequences from your own accounts, MPC Launcher candidate pitches, verified contacts with mobile numbers and daily hiring signals. Built by recruiters.

posts.name: Simple Listen
posts.tagline: Listen to your reading backlog in your podcast app
posts.description: Simple Listen turns text into AI-narrated audio episodes in your own podcast feed, for the times you can listen but can't read. Send an article link, paste text, forward an email, or use a long output from ChatGPT, Claude or another AI agent. It narrates the text with a high-quality voice, and you listen in Apple Podcasts, Overcast, Pocket Casts or another compatible podcast app.

posts.name: Ticketpal
posts.tagline: One shared place for your family's travel tickets
posts.description: One shared place for your family's travel tickets and bookings. Ask Claude or ChatGPT to sync in your trips, then open your shared travel plans on your phone. No need to forward booking emails! Our MCP connection means you can provide Claude/ChatGPT with context about all your family's travel plans or book stuff via other connectors (Uber; Booking.com...) Free for now, with planned pricing at $20 per year for a family of four, so 50% cheaper than our closest peers.

posts.name: Aitema
posts.tagline: Let your users tell you what to build
posts.description: Aitema gives your product a public page where users suggest features, report bugs and vote on them. You move requests through a roadmap and write a changelog entry when they ship.

posts.name: longbook
posts.tagline: An open-source alternative to Rocket Money, no bank login
posts.description: longbook turns your bank and card statements into a financial memory you own, so you see what leaves your accounts next, before the money is deducted. Code is open source, and your longbook is plain JSON files in your own iCloud. Search hundreds of statements, find commitments, people and accounts, get monthly reports. And no notifications. It is open to your Claude; and every change Claude does is shown as Proposals to keep or undo. v1.6.0 launches today 🚀

posts.name: Archseed
posts.tagline: Plan the work before your coding agent writes it
posts.description: Archseed is a CLI-first workflow for defining V1 scope, non-goals, and guardrails before you ask Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or another coding agent to implement. Start from one short project description, confirm the few decisions that matter, and get a reviewable project contract your coding agent can follow.

posts.name: Chalkie
posts.tagline: Ask anything. Watch it drawn and explained on a live board.
posts.description: Ask a question and Chalkie draws the answer on a board, stroke by stroke, while a voice explains each part. No walls of text. Circle any part of the drawing and ask about it, or type a follow-up, and it keeps drawing on the same board. Each lesson also gives you a 3D model on request, notes, a quiz, and a video export. Try free, no sign-in: chalkie.in/try. Plans from $4.99/mo.

posts.name: Devz Devi
posts.tagline: Devi builds your idea, run it, and help you find customers.
posts.description: Devi builds a real business site from a plain description in about 10 minutes, then helps you pitch it and find customers with drafted posts and outreach. Built for founders who don’t have time to code. You approve everything first.

posts.name: Buchlio
posts.tagline: Local-first bookkeeping for freelancers in Germany
posts.description: Buchlio reads receipts on your device, writes invoices and e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD) and hands your tax advisor a DATEV export. Your books stay on your device and sync through your own cloud. iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows. 30-day free trial.

posts.name: AgentOS by Formulate AI
posts.tagline: An AI workspace where people and agents run work together
posts.description: Formulate AI helps teams run work through a conversational AI assistant, specialised agents and shared company memory. Delegate tasks, coordinate people and agents, and keep humans in control with approvals. Built for founders and lean teams that want to scale execution without adding more operational overhead.

posts.name: DeployON
posts.tagline: Host Node, n8n, Python, Django, Next, Nuxt, Nest, Postgres
posts.description: Deploy ON is a managed Kubernetes PaaS from Proservice. We built it so teams in Georgia and beyond can ship from Git to a live HTTPS URL without writing cluster YAML, operating a container registry, or running cert-manager themselves. The control plane, billing, and support sit with Proservice in Tbilisi. Workloads run on Kubernetes with rolling updates, health checks, persistent volumes, and automatic TLS.

posts.name: Hiremast
posts.tagline: Tailored resumes for every job. No subscription, ever.
posts.description: Paste a job link. Hiremast builds a one-page, ATS-safe resume and cover letter for that job, using only your real experience. Track every application, see which skills jobs keep asking for, and check your ATS score free.

posts.name: ogdynamic
posts.tagline: Personalized OG, social & email images from a URL
posts.description: ogdynamic is a canvas editor and URL-based image generator for personalized visuals at any scale. Design a template once on a free-form canvas, mark layers as overridable, and generate OG images, social banners, blog covers, and product images from query parameters — no SDK required. The in-browser preview runs the same Rust rendering engine as the server, so what you design is exactly what renders. Ships with 86 templates and an MCP server for AI-native image design.

posts.name: Vigilbase OS
posts.tagline: AI security for everyone, even with no security team
posts.description: Attackers now use AI, and you shouldn't need a security team to keep up. Vigilbase OS plugs into the tools you already use. Vigil, our AI agent, reads every alert, tells you in plain words which ones need you, and has the fix ready to approve. Free to start.

posts.name: Control My PC
posts.tagline: Your phone as a trackpad, keyboard and shortcut deck
posts.description: Control My PC turns your Android phone into a trackpad, keyboard, shortcut grid and launcher for your Windows PC. Move the pointer, type live or write a draft and send it in one go, press one-tap shortcuts that switch with the app in front, and bring any open window forward. Scan a QR code to pair. No account, no ads, no servers: your phone and PC talk directly, encrypted. The Windows app is free; the phone app starts free.

posts.name: CampusLoop
posts.tagline: Your campus, verified & unfiltered.
posts.description: CampusLoop 2.0: one verified home for a whole college. Since our July launch we've added the Academic Vault (notes + previous-year questions), streaks and Loop Points, daily missions, and more utility hubs — buy & sell, housing, lost & found, ride shares. Everyone is a real student, verified by college email across 1,350+ Indian college domains. Browse as a guest, verify to post.

posts.name: Relationship Wrapped
posts.tagline: Your year becomes a story to scroll through.
posts.description: Your photos, dates, places and inside jokes become a story to scroll through. It lives at your own domain, behind a password only your chosen person will guess.

posts.name: PrepForCase
posts.tagline: Free case interview prep
posts.description: A free, step-by-step system for case interviews: learn the method in about 90 minutes, practise 102 cases with worked answers, drill maths, charts and market sizing, and follow a 1, 3 or 6-week plan.

posts.name: Scalp Score
posts.tagline: Shedding, oily or flaky scalp? Get your Scalp Score, free
posts.description: Shedding, an oily or flaky scalp, or breakage? Answer five questions for a free Scalp Score, no sign-up. Check products by barcode, name or ingredient photo, build a routine around your wash days, and keep a photo journal. No ads, no commissions. Android.

posts.name: entroit
posts.tagline: ERP software to handle more orders without more admin
posts.description: ERP software for wholesale, ecommerce, manufacturing and 3PL. Handle more orders without more admin. Your whole operation in one system. Go live in days, not weeks. With Professional, we migrate your data and train your team while your business keeps running. From €349 a month. No set-up fee. Free until it runs for you. See how it works.

posts.name: CSS Carousel Examples
posts.tagline: 60 CSS carousels, from 3D spirals to infinite loops, to copy
posts.description: Browse 60 carousels you can copy: a 3D tornado, helix and double helix, Möbius ring, panorama, infinite marquees, scroll snap, coverflow, parallax, drag-to-swipe stacks and more. Open any card to see a large live preview, change the card count, speed or radius, and copy the HTML and CSS in one click. Most of them run on CSS alone; the ones that need JavaScript are marked JS and include a short, plain snippet. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Fundability
posts.tagline: Operating system for business fundraising
posts.description: Fundability helps aspiring entrepreneurs, startups and SMEs create business plans, financial projections and pitch decks, assess investment readiness, fix weaknesses, prepare and share supporting evidence and contact best-fit investors, all from one place.

posts.name: Moonbird
posts.tagline: AI series where fans choose what happens next
posts.description: Videos, Shorts and series made with AI, shaped by their fans. Watch free, follow creators, choose the path a story takes and pitch what happens next. Creators upload from any AI tool or make it in the Studio, and fans send them sparks to make more.

posts.name: Grofer meal planner: budget weekly shop
posts.tagline: Plan your weekly shop to a budget.
posts.description: Plan your weekly shop to a budget. Pick real recipes, see what they cost at your supermarket, then fill your online basket or shop in store with a list.

posts.name: CupidWish: Send 3D Forever Rose Gifts
posts.tagline: Create your own gift card or send roses online
posts.description: CupidWish offers a unique digital gifting experience by allowing customers to create personalized 3D forever rose gifts paired with 60-second voice recordings and printable QR codes. These interactive keepsakes serve as a modern alternative to traditional flower delivery, providing instant worldwide dispatch via encrypted magic links or emails.

posts.name: Blinkimg
posts.tagline: Smaller images, same look: web, API, AI agents and WordPress
posts.description: Blinkimg makes images smaller, and they look the same. One account for a free web tool, an API, an MCP server for AI agents and a free WordPress plugin. WordPress plugin, live on WordPress.org: • Compresses new uploads, and your whole library in bulk • WebP and AVIF copies; your image URLs stay the same • A backup of every original, and Restore is free • Thumbnails count free • Unlimited on your own hosting, with no account Measured: a 9.8 MB photo became 131.2 KB as WebP, 98.7% smaller.

posts.name: Ank
posts.tagline: A Mac notepad where every line is a calculation
posts.description: Type a line the way you'd write it, like "rent = ₹28,000" or "15% off $598.50", and the answer sits beside it. Change one number and everything that depends on it updates. Live currencies, units, dates, EMI and SIP, lakh and crore, and plain-English questions answered by Apple Intelligence on your Mac. No account, no tracking; sheets are plain text files.

posts.name: DimensionKit Scorecards
posts.tagline: Build lead-generating scorecards with your own AI
posts.description: Turn your expertise into a scored assessment with Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor via MCP. Your AI builds the questions and scoring tiers; you review and publish. Visitors get a personal result with a radar chart and tailored insights. You get their email, answers and scores to guide follow-up. Visitors can also use their own AI to prepare answers, then review and submit. Share a link or embed it on your site. Free during open beta: 2 scorecards and 100 submissions/month.

posts.name: CCTV Privacy Law Mapper
posts.tagline: The privacy laws at every camera
posts.description: Paste your camera list, one line per camera. Every camera comes back with the privacy and surveillance laws we map at its site, each clause cited, and the ones we name but have not mapped. Eight lines free.

posts.name: RegWatch
posts.tagline: AI regulatory monitoring for any regulator, any jurisdiction
posts.description: RegWatch's AI agents monitor any regulator, gazette or law firm site, in any jurisdiction. Each change comes with a summary of why it matters to your business, and your team turns it into an obligation with an owner, deadline and audit evidence.

posts.name: DesignUGC
posts.tagline: Create Realistic AI UGC Video Ads for Your Brand
posts.description: DesignUGC turns product images into engaging AI UGC video ads. Choose a product, select an AI avatar, and generate creative video prompts with AI. Create authentic-looking product videos for TikTok, Instagram, and other social platforms without traditional filming or expensive production.

posts.name: QRmarket.ing
posts.tagline: QR codes you can change after you print them
posts.description: Make a good-looking QR code free, no sign-up. Go Pro to re-point it after it's printed, see scans by day, country and device, and export SVG or PDF without the watermark. Founding price this week: $45 for the first year.

posts.name: CozyMac
posts.tagline: Make it snow on your Mac. It piles up on your windows.
posts.description: CozyMac turns your desktop into a winter night. Snow settles on your windows and slides off when you shake them. Build a snowman, hang baubles that ring, send in a tiny snowplough, or let it follow your city's weather. $9.99 once.
